messages.subject: boxplot for faceting
parts:
Hi everyone:

I need some help from you guys. I am trying to use boxplot and faceting to represent my data. but I do not know how to set the parameters in ggplot. following is my code,please help me correct it.

thanks a lot.

library(reshape2)

dat=read.csv(file.choose())

dat[,3:ncol(dat)]=scale(dat[,3:ncol(dat)])


mydat <- melt(dat, id.vars = c("treatment", "cell.age"))


library(ggplot2)

p=ggplot(mydat,aes(x=cell.age,y=value,fill=treatment,group=treatment))+geom_boxplot()


> head(mydat)
  treatment cell.age     variable       value
1  Inoculum        0 Total.lipids -1.18369467
2    High P        3 Total.lipids  0.69282691
3     Low P        3 Total.lipids -0.04049452
4    High P        6 Total.lipids  0.62975640
5     Low P        6 Total.lipids -0.12881049
6    High P        9 Total.lipids -0.58346167

messages.author: afa3a78132320260
messages.subject: Re: boxplot for faceting
parts:
You don't say how you wan to to facet your data, but how about this (assuming you want to facet by the 'variable' column):

p=ggplot(mydat,aes(x=cell.age,y=value,fill=treatment,group=treatment))+geom_boxplot() + geom_wrap(~ variable)

Check the scales argument for geom_wrap() to manage the axes.

W.
